newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caldera may shake-up Venezuela cabinet - paper.
newsitem.headline: Caldera may shake-up Venezuela cabinet - paper.

text.p: Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera may shake-up his cabinet in the next few days, leading daily El Universal reported.

The newspaper's Miraflores presidential palace corespondent reported that among those who might be considered for change include Health Minister Pedro Rincon Gutierrez, Justice Minister Henrique Meier Echeverria, and Agriculture Minister Raul Alegrett Ruiz.
Alberto Poletto, the president of Venezuela's Investment Fund (FIV), the government body in charge of privatizations, has also been rumored as a possible candidate in any upcoming reshuffle.
